typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DestinationTable as string (),
	FileDate as string (),
	FileDateDt as timestamp (),
	FileDateStr as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	PackageExecutionID as integer (),
	QueryReadffromSrcDupe as string (),
	RowsDeleted as integer (),
	RowsDiscarded as integer (),
	RowsInserted as integer (),
	RowsNotWrittenError as integer (),
	RowsReadError as integer (),
	RowsReadNoError as integer (),
	RowsUpdated as integer (),
	FileArchiveDir as string (),
	FilePattern as string (),
	FileProcessDir as string (),
	ParentPackageExecutionID as integer (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		BRANCH as string,
		CUSTOMER as string,
		{PROJECT NUMBER} as string,
		{CUST CODE} as string,
		{SEQ #} as string,
		{JOB NAME} as string,
		{INVOICE #} as string,
		{INVOICED BY} as string,
		{SHIPPED DATE} as string,
		{OPEN A R} as string,
		{CREATED DATE} as string,
		{INV DATE} as string,
		{DUE DATE} as string,
		{SALES AGENT 1} as string,
		{SALES AGENT 2} as string,
		{CBG CODE} as string,
		{JOURNAL #} as string,
		reference as string,
		{ORIGINAL AMOUNT} as string,
		{CURRNET AMOUNT} as string,
		TAX as string,
		{AGING DAYS} as string,
		RETAINAGE as string,
		{CURRENT BALANCE} as string,
		{31 to 60 DAYS} as string,
		{61 to 90 DAYS} as string,
		{91 to 120 DAYS} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSv
ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSv derive() ~> ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSvErrorReformat
ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSv split(trim(INVOICE ) == '' || trim(OPEN A R) == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Discard,PassThru)
ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSv aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowsReadNoErrorAGGREGATE
ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSvErrorReformat derive() ~> ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSv0
RowsReadNoErrorAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowsReadNoErrorCACHESINK
ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSv0 sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn()) ~> ReadfromAgilityOpenARCSvERROROUTPUTFILE
ConditionalSplit@PassThru derive(FileName = toString(replace(FileName, toString($FileProcessDir), toString(''))),
		ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = PackageExecutionID,
		InvoiceBK = toString((ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString({CUST CODE}),' ')),' ') + '|' + ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString({SEQ }),' ')),' ') + '|' + ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString({INVOICE }),' ')),' ') + '|' + ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString({CREATED DATE}),' ')),' '))),
		FileDate = toString(FileDate),
		{CUST Ship To} = toString((rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString({CUST CODE}),' ')),' ') + '-' + right(lpad('', 3, '0') + rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString({SEQ }),' ')),' '), 3))),
		{CUST CODE} = rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString({CUST CODE}),' ')),' '),
		RETAINAGE = iif({CBG CODE} == 'Retainage', {OPEN A R}, '0'),
		{PROJECT NUMBER} = rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString({CUST CODE}),' ')),' ') + '-' + right(lpad('', 3, '0') + rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString({SEQ }),' ')),' '), 3)) ~> DeriveAuditandOtherColumns
DeriveAuditandOtherColumns sink(input(
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BRANCH as string,
		DUE_DATE as string,
		CREATED_DATE as string,
		INVOICED_BY as string,
		RETAINAGE as string,
		FileName as string,
		PROJECT_NUMBER as string,
		CBG_CODE as string,
		CUST_Ship_to as string,
		TAX as string,
		INV_DATE as string,
		SALES_AGENT_1 as string,
		reference as string,
		SALES_AGENT_2 as string,
		FileDate as string,
		InvoiceBK as string,
		JOURNAL__ as string,
		ORIGINAL_AMOUNT as string,
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		CUST_CODE as string,
		OPEN_A_R as string,
		INVOICE__ as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate,
		BRANCH,
		DUE_DATE = {DUE DATE},
		CREATED_DATE = {CREATED DATE},
		INVOICED_BY = {INVOICED BY},
		RETAINAGE,
		FileName,
		PROJECT_NUMBER = {PROJECT NUMBER},
		CBG_CODE = {CBG CODE},
		CUST_Ship_to = {CUST Ship To},
		TAX,
		INV_DATE = {INV DATE},
		SALES_AGENT_1 = {SALES AGENT 1},
		reference,
		SALES_AGENT_2 = {SALES AGENT 2},
		FileDate,
		InvoiceBK,
		JOURNAL__ = {JOURNAL #},
		ORIGINAL_AMOUNT = {ORIGINAL AMOUNT},
		ETLExecutionID,
		CUST_CODE = {CUST CODE},
		OPEN_A_R = {OPEN A R},
		INVOICE__ = {INVOICE #})) ~> WritetoTarget
